fact: On 28 August 2025 UNDP reported that the Liberia National Police's Research and Planning Division launched a three-day refresher training in Monrovia, supported by UNDP, for 43 Reporting Officers on the upgraded Crime Statistics Information System, a DHIS2-based platform described as enabling real-time crime data collection; it names no station or county and does not say where the officers enter the data.
title: LNP Trains Officers on Upgraded Crime Reporting Platform
